objective: Validate task-0 stage measurements on independent successful controls before assigning any failure stage or proposing a one-variable policy intervention.

basis.existing_replay_population: 24 final-checkpoint traces, including 14 source successes and 10 failures; already inspected and ineligible as an untouched confirmatory set
basis.invalidated_proxy: The predeclared end-effector-to-bowl <=0.05 m approach event appeared in only 5/14 successful traces. It is not a validated necessary predecessor under the existing capture semantics.
basis.closed_loop_gate: 40k single-task task0: 11/20 paired and 3/5 fixed-init3; registered 5/5 repeatability criterion failed

alternatives.option: Relabel the nine existing failures as approach failures or tune the 0.05 m threshold on the same outcomes
alternatives.benefit: Would produce a superficially complete stage table without new simulator work.
alternatives.cost_and_bias: The purported necessary approach event is absent in most successful controls; outcome-guided tuning on the 24 traces leaks the answer and cannot validate the label.
alternatives.falsifier: Any successful untouched control without the tuned necessary approach event invalidates that stage rule.

alternatives.option: Inventory genuinely disjoint archived successful action traces and validate simulator-native observables by action replay only
alternatives.benefit: Could validate measurement using existing policy actions without training or fresh policy inference, while preserving an independent confirmatory population.
alternatives.cost_and_bias: Archived action/state traces and exact task/reset/protocol metadata may not exist; replay parity, object identity, and success checks are mandatory. This design does not authorize replay execution.
alternatives.falsifier: No disjoint success traces exist, replay parity fails, or a claimed necessary stage event is absent on any untouched successful control.

alternatives.option: Register a fresh instrumented successful-control collection using a frozen positive model
alternatives.benefit: Can create a disjoint confirmatory set with exact capture semantics if archived traces are insufficient.
alternatives.cost_and_bias: Requires new policy inference/GPU rollouts, unique private output roots, a fixed checkpoint/evaluator, declared seeds/initializations, and separate explicit approval.

alternatives.option: Immediately retrain or expand to more tasks
alternatives.benefit: Would produce more checkpoints or task-count results.
alternatives.cost_and_bias: The single-task repeatability and four-task progression gates failed; measurement validity is unresolved, so such runs have no predeclared causal interpretation.

requirements: Enumerate archived success-trace locations, exact task/BDDL, checkpoint family, evaluator and seed/init metadata without moving or publishing raw traces.
Exclude every action trajectory in the already-inspected 24-trace population from an untouched confirmatory set.
Pin immutable source file hashes before selecting controls; record a fixed inventory and selection rule rather than choosing by convenient stage events.
If no eligible disjoint successes exist, record that limitation and prepare a separately authorized collection protocol; do not improvise a new rollout.

measurement_validity_rules.source_replay_parity: For any future recorded-action replay, require exact success and step-count agreement, reward tolerance and robot-state tolerance from the registered replay protocol before using stage observations.
measurement_validity_rules.object_identity: Resolve bowl/plate names from the active official task BDDL and simulator; fail closed on missing or ambiguous objects.
measurement_validity_rules.necessary_event_claim: A stage proxy may be called a necessary predecessor only if it is observed in every untouched successful positive control under the frozen capture semantics; any miss invalidates that claim for this protocol.
measurement_validity_rules.thresholds: Do not tune thresholds using the already-inspected 24 outcomes or the untouched confirmatory set. If exploratory calibration is needed, predeclare a separate development set and then freeze the rule before confirmatory evaluation.
measurement_validity_rules.native_terminal: The official task success predicate is the terminal ground truth. Geometric/contact proxies remain descriptive unless separately validated as necessary stage events.
measurement_validity_rules.failed_validation: Preserve raw observations and mark stage classification invalid or ambiguous. Do not silently substitute a relaxed proxy or retroactively reclassify existing failures.

future_experiment_gate: After measurement validity, register a single falsifiable training/data hypothesis with one controlled variable, matched per-task sample and learning-rate exposure, independent output roots, fixed evaluation criteria and stop conditions. New training or policy inference still requires a separate explicit authorization; no task-count expansion or Fold02 unlock follows from this design.
next_safe_action: Read-only inventory of disjoint archived successful controls and their metadata; do not execute replay or policy inference during inventory.
